events.evidence: A Syrian Arab Air Force or Russian airstrike reportedly kills a dozen people at a market selling diesel fuel in the rebel-held Idlib Governorate.
South Korea and the United States start a joint military exercise as North Korea repeats threats of "indiscriminate" nuclear strikes.
The EU plans to boost aid to Greece and declare the route north through the Balkans closed. Presently, about 13,000 people are stranded at the Greece-Macedonia border

label.note: Syria and North Korea threats plus EU migrant crisis dominate; M&A and Apple add corporate noise.
